(๑•̀ㅂ•́)૭☒|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 16 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Lead Boss''' was a large [[Enemies|enemy]] which appeared only on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. It had high health for its debut, but was quite slow while it has full metal coverings. As it is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy, it cannot be damaged by towers without lead detection. The '''Lead Boss''' loses its metal coverings based on how much damage it received, and how many times it was damaged. Because of this, the '''Lead Boss''' can lose its metal coverings at different times depending on what towers are damaging it. After its health drops below 80-151 health (depending on how the metal coverings are destroyed), enough of its coverings would have been destroyed so that the '''Lead Boss''' loses its [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] properties and thus can be attacked by all towers and [[units]]. As more and more metal coverings are destroyed, the '''Lead Boss''' speeds up. After its health drops below 30-121 health, all of its metal coverings would have been removed and it would have become significantly faster than before. The '''Lead Boss''' could be spawned by the [[Grave Digger]] in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. The [[Mystery]] and [[Mystery Boss]] could also spawn the '''Lead Boss''' upon their deaths in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current '''Lead Boss''' is similar to the first version, however when it is exposed, it is faceless instead. |Original |The original '''Lead Boss''' was completely metal-plated from its head to its legs. After more damage was dealt to the '''Lead Boss''', some of the metal covering was destroyed. After enough damage has been done, the '''Lead Boss''' was exposed. It had blue skin, and its torso and legs were brown. It had a drooling zombie face and is larger than the [[Abnormal]]. }} ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Like the [[Abnormal Boss]], the '''Lead Boss''' is a major spike in health compared to previous enemies, and additional defense is necessary. **Lead detection is required to take this boss down. The [[Golden Pyromancer]] is a good option, and multiple Level 1 [[Trapper]]s can also be effective, as well as a Level 3 [[Golden Scout]]. ***These are also the most effective options to deal with '''Lead Bosses''' that spawn from [[Mystery|Mysteries]] early on. **A Level 2 [[Brawler]] can be effective at taking down the '''Lead Boss''', but if you have additional defenses without lead detection, then one or two Level 0 should be able to take down its lead armor. **The [[Elf Camp]]'s units deal low collision damage, but in the mid game [[Gift Bomber]]s and [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elves]] are effective to damage the '''Lead Boss'''. **The Level 1+ [[Pursuit]] is a cost effective option that can also detect flying enemies, though it might be too expensive early on in the game. ***After the metal coverings have been removed, all towers can damage the '''Lead Boss'''. Towers like the [[Golden Scout]] or [[Ace Pilot]] are now more useful. ****Be aware that the '''Lead Boss''' may get out of range of these towers before its metal coverings get removed. **Slowing towers like the [[Sledger]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be used, though the [[Freezer]] is unable to damage the '''Lead Boss'''. The [[Electroshocker]], [[Warden]], [[Frost Blaster]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Sledger]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] can damage the '''Lead Boss'''. ***In particular, Level 3+ [[Warden]]s are very good against '''Lead Bosses''' as [[Warden]]s deal lots of damage and have lead detection, meaning they can kill '''Lead Bosses''' very quickly. *[[Mystery|Mysteries]] are able to spawn the '''Lead Boss''' in huge numbers. Additional defense is even more important here, especially if the '''Lead Bosses''' from previous waves had proven troublesome. **Earlier hordes of [[Mystery]] spawned '''Lead Bosses''' should be dealt with using the same tactics above. **When in the mid game, towers like the [[Accelerator]] and [[Ranger]] become options and are fairly good at dealing with such hordes. The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] are also helpful. ***Once the metal coverings are removed, all high DPS towers can be used. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Metal Break |- |[[File:Break.ogg]] |'''Lead Boss''' losing metal coverings |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} LeadBossWalk.gif|Walking animation (29 October 2020 - Present) LeadBossExposed.gif|Walking animation (8 May 2021 - Present) LeadBossLastBreath.gif|Walking animation (8 May 2021 - Present) {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} LeadBoss0.png|First Version (Without Covering) (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLeadBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexLeadBoss.png|'''Lead Boss''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Lead Boss''' may be a reference to the [[w:c:bloons:Lead Bloon|Lead Bloon]] in the ''Bloons Tower Defense'' series. *Without the metal covering its body, this enemy looks similar to the [[Zombegg]] and the [[Eggsplosive]]. **It also looks similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Speedy|Speedy]] from ''Tower Battles''. *The '''Lead Boss''', alongside the [[Lead (Legacy Enemy)|Lead]] and [[Lead Balloon]] have unique spark particles when they are hit by an attack that cannot detect lead enemies. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Lead Boss''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **Appearance changed. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Lead Boss''' does not speed up after losing its covering. *'''13 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]b **{{Bugfix}} '''Lead Boss''' now speeds up after losing its covering. *'''30 April 2025''' - [[v1.63.0]] **{{Bug}} '''Lead Boss''' no longer uses the death sound effect. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Lead Boss''' removed from the main game, as it has been replaced by [[Elite Lead]]. Now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{Hardcore|[[Lead (Legacy Enemy)|Lead]]|Wave 14|Lead Boss|Wave 16|[[Mystery]]|Wave 17|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
